historical_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive side-by-side values only. Protocols, training availability, replay, execution conditions and evaluated populations differ; no causal effect, paired test, significance or superiority is inferred. Planned coverage is not directly comparable after deliberate policy exclusion.

metric_contract.average_precision: exact noninterpolated ranking with tied scores grouped
metric_contract.binary_seed_std: sample standard deviation, ddof=1; null when n<=1
metric_contract.cost: Scenario estimates/objective units remain distinct from invoiced expenditure.
metric_contract.f1_macro: arithmetic mean of both binary class F1
metric_contract.fixed_stream: Seeds repeat executions; they need not produce independent stream realizations.
metric_contract.paired: core.metrics.Metrics on common event_id intersection per dataset/model
metric_contract.replication_std: population standard deviation, ddof=0, as the replication protocol

normalization: Machine paths and connection secrets omitted; numeric evidence unchanged. source_report_sha256 identifies original bytes; retained_report_sha256 identifies gzip bytes.

representation.array_values: stored in full at each cataloged artifact/pointer location
representation.json_pointer: RFC 6901, relative to the complete artifact JSON root
representation.numeric_leaves_default: unchanged; dense-vector references are explicit export views only

payload_encoding.large_reports_replications: sorted compact UTF-8 JSON + deterministic gzip level 6
payload_encoding.small_reports_replications: sorted pretty UTF-8 JSON + deterministic gzip level 9

representation.scientific_payload_schema: unchanged; complete reports and replications retained

table_files_contract.reconstruction: read parts in listed order; keep the first CSV header and skip subsequent repeated headers; use UTF-8 and the canonical Excel CSV dialect
table_files_contract.shard_bound: each compressed part is strictly smaller than max_shard_compressed_bytes
table_files_contract.sharded_table: descriptor with format=csv+gzip-shards and an ordered shards list
table_files_contract.source_row_range: zero-based, half-open data-row positions excluding the repeated header

representation.vector_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON array with sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':'), allow_nan=False
